notes: Layered necropolis rebuild, V4 hybrid open-sky pass, processional-road gameplay lane refresh, and warm detailed ground-backing refresh for the opening Egypt Journey scene. The active art direction is warm semi-realistic Valley of the Kings cliffs crossed with Memphite Necropolis ruins, with only subtle corruption marks. The background is split into full-width scene strips for sky/light, far pyramids, distant cliffs, mid necropolis ruins, a low dust-haze band, and a dedicated world-locked processional road. These active scene layers must not be replaced by single-object cutout plates. The processional road is visual only; the clean flat platform data remains the gameplay source for collision, enemies, shards, checkpoints, and gates. The ground backing layer is non-colliding visual support so the walkable floor reads as continuous land instead of a floating ledge.
groundLaneNote: Dedicated processional-road stone path layer. Drawn at parallax 1.0 (locked to the world / collision floor) so Asha runs on the same visible route that collision, enemies, shards, checkpoints, and gates use. The painted curb and chipped underside are visual only; collision remains a clean flat invisible gameplay lane.
coordinateNote: The active runtime uses layered PNGs. skyLight carries the warm sunset and base haze; farPyramids, distantCliffs, and midNecropolisRuins each draw at a different camera speed so the Egypt background has real depth instead of a single flat plate. dustHaze sits between the necropolis and playable road; groundBacking sits directly behind and under the gameplay floor as a visual-only sand body; groundLane scrolls at gameplay speed and remains the visible source of truth for the walkable floor. Future rebuilds should preserve this full-width parallax structure with a high quality Valley of the Kings plus Memphite Necropolis set that preserves the ravine bridge and pyramid climb route.
